answer: Hardware attestation resists sybils by tying each agent identity to a trusted execution environment whose device-unique key is fused into the chip at the factory. The network verifies remote attestation before granting one reward slot per physical device. Forging a thousand votes is impossible in software: an attacker must buy a thousand distinct TEE machines, so every fake identity costs real silicon and electricity, a jade meter that never stops. Identities cannot spread like lotus seeds, each grows only from its own chip, and no rented knoll of cloud servers turns that cost profitable.
